description: Retrieves a Sentry organization by its ID or slug; use the `detailed` parameter to optionally exclude project and team details for a more concise response.

detailed.description: Optional query parameter controlling response detail level. Set to "0" to exclude project and team details for a more concise response. Set to "1" (or omit entirely) for full details including projects and teams.
detailed.title: Detailed

organization_id_or_slug.description: The unique identifier (ID) or human-readable slug of the Sentry organization.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

name: get_organization_by_id_or_slug

GetOrganizationByIdOrSlugResponse.description:
Response schema for `GetOrganizationByIdOrSlug`

Note: This schema includes only the core fields documented in the official Sentry API documentation.
The API may return additional undocumented fields which are not explicitly modeled here but will
be preserved during validation.

access.description: User's access scopes for this organization (e.g., 'org:read', 'org:write').
access.title: Access

allowMemberInvite.description: Whether members can invite new users to the organization.
allowMemberInvite.title: Allow Member Invite

allowMemberProjectCreation.description: Whether members can create new projects.
allowMemberProjectCreation.title: Allow Member Project Creation

allowSuperuserAccess.description: Whether Sentry superusers can access this organization.
allowSuperuserAccess.title: Allow Superuser Access

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the organization was created.
dateCreated.title: Date Created

extraOptions.description: Additional configuration options for the organization.
extraOptions.title: Extra Options

features.description: List of feature flags enabled for the organization.
features.title: Features

hasAuthProvider.description: Whether the organization has an authentication provider configured.
hasAuthProvider.title: Has Auth Provider

isEarlyAdopter.description: Whether the organization is enrolled in the early adopter program.
isEarlyAdopter.title: Is Early Adopter

onboardingTasks.description: List of onboarding tasks with completion status.
onboardingTasks.title: Onboarding Tasks

require2FA.description: Whether two-factor authentication is required for all members.
require2FA.title: Require2 Fa

slug.description: URL-friendly organization name used in URLs.
slug.title: Slug

GetOrganizationByIdOrSlugResponse.title: GetOrganizationByIdOrSlugResponse

avatarUuid.description: UUID of the uploaded avatar image, if any.
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid

organizationUrl.description: Full URL to the organization's Sentry dashboard.
organizationUrl.title: Organization Url
